body.statement: For the construction in \(\mathrm{def:paired\text{-}witness}\), every fixed \(P_B^{k,r_0}\) belongs to \(\mathcal P_T\) and satisfies \(\psi_T(P_B^{k,r_0},c)=1/2\), whereas \(\psi_T(P_0^{k,r_0},c)=1/2+b_{r_0}(\eta)\) with \(b_{r_0}(\eta)\geq c\sqrt{r_0/T}/16\). Moreover, \(\operatorname{TV}((P_0^{k,r_0})^n,\overline P_1^{(n,k,r_0)})\leq\rho_{n,k}\). At \(k=1,r_0=2,n=2\), the mixture total variation is exactly \(3/8\), shifted partner masses cancel, and the functional differs from a static tilt.
body.justification: This is the required destructive audit of the sparse-history lower mechanism before it is used in a frontier theorem.
body.gap: ZengBalakrishnanHanKennedy2024Discrete uses within-category collisions for a one-time treatment functional; complement-paired whole subtrees and exact sequential target cancellation are different proof objects.
body.consumer: The witness supplies all-estimator and all-randomized-interval converses without assuming concentration of a random target.
